test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 21 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Select the industry in which goods are produced in the home of the producer.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Cottage industry**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **A cottage industry **is a small-scale, decentralised manufacturing firm that is often run from a house rather than a dedicated facility.
 
• The amount of capital required to start a cottage industry, as well as the number of** people employed, define cottage industries**.
 
• They frequently concentrate on the creation of labour-intensive commodities, but they face severe competition from factory-based businesses that mass-produce things.
 
• Cottage industries play an important part in developing countries' economies.
 
• Larger industries may require money and financial infrastructures that these economies lack.
 
• Smaller businesses may find it difficult to expand due to a lack of available cash or uncertainties surrounding private property and legal rights. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Large-scale industries** are defined as those with extensive infrastructure, raw materials, significant workforce demands, and high capital requirements.
 
• The intellectual or knowledge-based economy is represented by the **quaternary sector or quaternary industry.** 
 
• The raw materials produced by the primary sector are processed into manufactured commodities and products by **secondary industries**.
